model_annotation: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates negative log probabilities across various "Per-specialty terms" for a base model and six fine-tuned models. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by "Per-specialty terms," ordered alphabetically from left to right as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical value axis represents "Negative log probability" on a linear scale, descending from -22 at the top to -27 at the bottom with tick marks at 1-unit intervals. The bars visually extend downwards from the -22 baseline. Within each category, the data is displayed as a group of seven adjacent bars. According to the legends at the top, the leftmost bar in each group is light blue and represents "Mistralv0.2-Base." The remaining six bars in each group correspond to models "Fine-tuned on:" specific domains, indicated by a sequence of colors from left to right: very light beige for Cardio, light beige for Gastro, peach for Infect, light orange for Neuro, tan for Obstetrics, and brown for Pediatrics. Across the chart, the light blue base model bars consistently extend the furthest downwards; the longest bar overall is the base model in the Cardio category, reaching approximately -26.8. In contrast, the fine-tuned model bars are consistently shorter, with the shortest bars located in the Infect category, extending only to approximately -23.0. The categories on the horizontal axis and the sequence of fine-tuned models within each group both follow an alphabetical order, and no individual bars receive additional visual emphasis.
